steps.title: Rights Radar
steps.caption: At intake Peshkar ran the 7 rules of the Rights Radar on the dossier as of 2026-11-15: date arithmetic and statute tables, not the language model. Default bail: WINDOW_CLOSED, Undertrial limit (BNSS s.479): CHECK, Production within 24 hours: CHECK, Antil category: C and Statutory bar: BAR_APPLIES. Each result names its rule and the dates it used; rules not yet re-checked against the bare act are marked unverified.

filled.label: Default bail
filled.value: WINDOW_CLOSED: 180-day NDPS s.36A(4) limit. Day 1 is the first remand, 16.01.2026. The special-act limit replaces 60/90 days and the Court may extend it to 365 days. The charge sheet was filed on day 167 (01.07.2026). It came within the limit, so the right to default bail never arose.

filled.label: Undertrial limit (BNSS s.479)
filled.value: CHECK: Maximum punishment not on record, so the threshold cannot be compared. The maximum under NDPS s.29 is set by the clause and the quantity (small, lesser than commercial, or commercial), and the charge does not name a clause, so counsel must read it from the charge sheet.

filled.label: Notice of appearance
filled.value: UNKNOWN: Maximum punishment is not on record. The maximum under NDPS s.29 is set by the clause and the quantity (small, lesser than commercial, or commercial), and the charge does not name a clause, so counsel must read it from the charge sheet.

filled.label: Grounds of arrest
filled.value: UNKNOWN: No record that the grounds of arrest were communicated.

filled.label: Production within 24 hours
filled.value: CHECK: Produced the next day; times not on record.

filled.label: Antil category
filled.value: C: Charged under a special act with stringent bail provisions (NDPS s.37): category C. Antil's categories decide how an accused who was not arrested during investigation and cooperated is treated after the charge sheet; for a client in custody this is context, not a bail entitlement.

filled.label: Statutory bar
filled.value: BAR_APPLIES: NDPS 21(c): NDPS s.37(1)(b) twin conditions apply (s.19, s.24, s.27A, or commercial quantity): the Public Prosecutor must be heard and the court must find reasonable grounds to believe the accused is not guilty and not likely to offend on bail. If the arrest breached Art. 22(1), see the grounds_of_arrest check (Vihaan Kumar). Also to check: NDPS 29: NDPS s.37(1)(b) reaches only s.19, s.24, s.27A and commercial quantity; the quantity involved is not on record, so check it.

hi.title: Demo · NDPS व्यावसायिक मात्रा, s.37 रोक, एक स्कैन किया हुआ पृष्ठ
hi.story: Accused-1 पर NDPS 21(c) और 29 के तहत आरोप है कि उसके द्वारा चलाई जा रही कार से 1.2 kg हेरोइन बरामद हुई, जो व्यावसायिक मात्रा है, इसलिए जमानत के लिए s.37 की दोहरी शर्तें आवश्यक हैं। आरोप-पत्र NDPS Act के 180 दिनों के भीतर आ गया, उसकी पिछली जमानत अर्जी खारिज कर दी गई थी, उसका एक अन्य NDPS मामला लंबित है और जब्ती मेमो केवल एक स्कैन की गई छवि है।
